snippet.title: My Own Murder - Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3130420/My_Own_Murder/

My Own Murder is a first-person narrative puzzle game set in 1971, in San Antonio. Play Edgar McGee, a washed-up private detective, and investigate the murder of rising music star Minnie Williams.
